title: Vision of a Man

questions.question: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, Daniel was mourning for how long?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:2 (ESV): "In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three weeks."

questions.question: What did Daniel see standing on the bank of the great river Tigris?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:5 (ESV): "I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, a man clothed in linen,"

questions.question: What happened to the men who were with Daniel when he saw the vision?
options: A great trembling fell upon them, and they fled to hide
questions.correctAnswer: A great trembling fell upon them, and they fled to hide
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:7 (ESV): "but a great trembling fell upon them, and they fled to hide themselves."

questions.question: When Daniel heard the sound of the man's words, what happened to him?
options: He fell on his face in deep sleep with his face to the ground
questions.correctAnswer: He fell on his face in deep sleep with his face to the ground
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:9 (ESV): "then I fell on my face in deep sleep with my face to the ground."

questions.question: Who touched Daniel and set him trembling on his hands and knees?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:10 (ESV): "And behold, a hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands and knees."

questions.question: The man said he had come because of Daniel's what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:12 (ESV): "and I have come because of your words."

questions.question: Who withstood the man for twenty-one days?
options: The prince of the kingdom of Persia
questions.correctAnswer: The prince of the kingdom of Persia
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:13 (ESV): "The prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days,"

questions.question: Who came to help the man against the prince of Persia?
options: Michael, one of the chief princes
questions.correctAnswer: Michael, one of the chief princes
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:13 (ESV): "but Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me,"

questions.question: The man came to make Daniel understand what is to happen to his people in the what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:14 (ESV): "and came to make you understand what is to happen to your people in the latter days. For the vision is for days yet to come."

questions.question: What strengthened Daniel when he was weak?
options: One having the appearance of a man touched him again
questions.correctAnswer: One having the appearance of a man touched him again
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:18 (ESV): "Then again one having the appearance of a man touched me and strengthened me."

questions.question: The man said he will return to fight against whom?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:20 (ESV): "But now I will return to fight against the prince of Persia;"

questions.question: When the man goes out, who will come?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:20 (ESV): "and when I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come."

questions.question: No one contends by the man's side against these except whom?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:21 (ESV): "There is none who contends by my side against these except Michael, your prince."

questions.question: What book did the man say he would tell Daniel the truth from?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:21 (ESV): "But I will tell you what is inscribed in the book of truth:"

questions.question: Description of the man: his body was like beryl, his face like the appearance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, and his arms and legs like what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 10:6 (ESV): "his arms and legs like the gleam of polished bronze,"

key_verse_text: Then he said to me, "Fear not, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand and humbled yourself before your God, your words have been heard, and I have come because of your words."
